Breadcrumbs
These building blocks are used to start and stop an automation flow.
The
Start
block is the starting point of all automation flows, is always present and cannot be deleted.
The
Pass
and
Fail
blocks are used to explicitly end a case run immediately in a passed or failed state, while the
Done
block is used to end a case run in a state that is neither. This distinction can be very useful in some test automation scenarios, whereas others may not need it.
